schema: dem.lock v1: pinned LOLA products (datasets[0] = LDEM_85S_20M for RF terrain and the near solar horizon; ldem_75s_240m_float = far solar horizon). Ranged responses must report this size and ETag; tiles are checked against min/max; `python -m backend.domain.grazing.dem --verify-full` re-checks the sha256 of the whole file.
provenance: Trust-on-first-use: sha256 computed by streaming the whole file once over HTTPS from pds-geosciences.wustl.edu (PDS publishes no checksum for this file). Retrieval date 2026-10-26. Label values (scale, offset, size, DERIVED_MINIMUM/MAXIMUM) read from the .lbl. LDEM_75S_240M: sha256 of the whole 58 125 376-byte file computed by streaming it once over HTTPS on 2026-11-04 (file not kept); size, ETag and label sha256 recorded the same day. LDEM_128_FLOAT (2026-11-05): size, ETag and label sha256 recorded from the PDS server; `sha256` is the whole-file hash (4 246 732 800 bytes, computed once by streaming on 2026-11-05, file not kept); an empty `sha256` would mean NOT computed.

orientation.note: col = c0 + rho sin(lon)/scale, row = c0 - rho cos(lon)/scale, rho = 2 R tan((90+lat)/2); checked 2026-10-26 on Shackleton (bowl: floor -2.8 km, rim ~ +0.6 km at 9-10 km), Haworth (-3.3 km), Malapert Massif (+4.9 km); each of the 7 mirrored/rotated variants fails on at least one of these features

datasets.credit: LRO LOLA Gridded Data Record LDEM_85S_20M (NASA/GSFC, D. E. Smith PI), PDS Geosciences Node; heights in km relative to a 1737.4 km sphere, polar stereographic (spherical), pixel registration

orientation.note: same polar stereographic convention as LDEM_85S_20M (shared PDS map projection); confirmed independently on 2026-11-04 by the LROC WAC illumination map comparison (docs/domain/validation.md)

datasets.credit: LRO LOLA Gridded Data Record LDEM_75S_240M (NASA/GSFC, D. E. Smith PI), PDS Geosciences Node; heights in km relative to a 1737.4 km sphere, polar stereographic (spherical); used only for the far solar horizon (10-200 km)

orientation.note: simple cylindrical, pixel registered, 128 pixel/deg: row = (90 - lat) * 128 - 0.5, col = lon_east(0..360) * 128 - 0.5 (label: LINE_PROJECTION_OFFSET 11519.5, SAMPLE_PROJECTION_OFFSET 23039.5, CENTER_LONGITUDE 180, WESTERNMOST_LONGITUDE 0, POSITIVE_LONGITUDE_DIRECTION EAST); orientation checked 2026-11-05 against LDEM_75S_240M at 18 points (86 to 88 S, six longitudes 10..330 E): rms difference 1.9 m on a 924 m standard deviation, correlation 0.999998

datasets.credit: LRO LOLA Gridded Data Record LDEM_128_FLOAT (NASA/GSFC, D. E. Smith PI), PDS Geosciences Node; global shape map, simple cylindrical, 128 pixel/degree (0.236901 km/pixel at the equator), heights in km relative to a 1737.4 km sphere; used for custom sites outside the polar products, tiles only (the 4.2 GB file is never downloaded whole)
